credit for legislation eliminating the Patriot Penalty, including a unanimously approved amendment he offered with Durbin."}},"codebook":{"definition":"Credit-claiming occurs when a senator presents themself, alone or with colleagues, as responsible for obtaining, creating, advancing, protecting, or delivering a concrete governmental policy, program, funding award, official decision, or constituent benefit.","clarification":"Code as credit-claiming when the release attributes a result or meaningful legislative/administrative advancement to the senator's own action. Relevant actions include introducing, authoring, sponsoring, securing, negotiating, obtaining, helping win, requesting and receiving, or successfully amending legislation; obtaining federal funding or a designation; and claiming that an agency acted in response to the senator's intervention. Credit may be shared with other legislators or officials. A bill's introduction or a senator's sponsorship counts because the senator is claiming ownership of a specific policy initiative, even if it has not yet become law.","positive_examples":[{"document_id":"1862","explanation":"Baucus and Tester explicitly state that they delivered on their promise to secure $12.5 million for Butte military projects."},{"document_id":"2318","explanation":"Durbin claims that he secured an expedited environmental review and restored the airport project to the federal funding priority list."},{"document_id":"1257","explanation":"DeWine ties a local fire grant to legislation he wrote and passed and to funding he helped secure."}],"negative_clarification":"Do not code as credit-claiming when a senator only states a policy preference, explains a vote, criticizes or praises another official, offers condolences or commemoration, announces an agency award without claiming a role in obtaining it, or requests future action without presenting a resulting achievement. Mere participation in a hearing, meeting, or event is insufficient unless the release attributes a concrete result to that participation.","negative_examples":[{"document_id":"656","explanation":"Kerry criticizes the administration's port-security failures but does not claim to have delivered a policy result."},{"document_id":"1957","explanation":"Dodd and Lieberman announce airport grant funding, but do not say they secured or influenced the award."},{"document_id":"918","explanation":"Allard simply invites constituents to a town meeting and makes no claim of accomplishment."}]}}
